findings.origin: Created by R7-B.1 (the QE-R7B-R2-03 fix adds the question; at FREEZE-2 the same change was applied, climbing the ladder). Eligible for the contract's single correction cycle.
findings.title: The NO_LOWER_SKILL_ALTERNATIVE question can be a dead end: 'Name a <pattern> exercise' has no effect, its missing input cannot be supplied in the review it answers, and its text can name equipment that is available
reproduction: probes/q04-no-lower-skill.mjs -> out/q04-no-lower-skill.json: the R7-B.1 test fixture (DUMBBELLS+BANDS, GENERAL, FIXED, reviewed to week 3; db-row SKILL_MISMATCH -> band-row; week 3 reviewed). Week 4 EQUIPMENT_CHANGE {equipment:['DUMBBELLS']} -> ASK NO_LOWER_SKILL_ALTERNATIVE, options ['Keep the equipment','Name a pull exercise'], missingInputs ['changes.equipment','substitution.to']. Resubmitting the same EQUIPMENT_CHANGE with substitution.to = each of the 17 pull configurations: 17/17 ASK (the equipment change does not read substitution). An EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION of band-row naming each pull: only band-pulldown is accepted (it needs the same bands); the equipment change after it asks again. Same for a dated window (S2) and for the substitution path with a window ahead (S3: naming any pull, 17/17 ASK).

probes/q05-no-lower-skill-grid.mjs -> out/q05-no-lower-skill-grid.json: 96 programs, 462 SKILL_MISMATCH substitutions applied, 97 equipment changes removing an item the substitute needs: 46 NO_LOWER_SKILL_ALTERNATIVE questions; 13 are dead ends (no naming of any same-pattern configuration, with either reason, lets the change be recorded afterwards); 0 of 46 are resolved by resubmitting the same review with substitution.to.

probes/q12-no-lower-full-equipment.mjs -> out/q12-no-lower-full-equipment.json: FULL equipment, RUNNING_SUPPORT, 3 strength days, INTERMEDIATE, FIXED. Control without a SKILL_MISMATCH: losing the bands -> MODIFY (band-row -> one-arm-db-row, db-row). With db-row (ACCESSORY) set aside for SKILL_MISMATCH -> band-face-pull, losing the bands -> ASK 'band-face-pull needs bands that is not available ... name the pull exercise to use'. 28 naming attempts (of band-face-pull and of band-row, 7 pulls, both reasons): 24 substitutions applied, 0 then let the equipment change be recorded. After naming one-arm-db-row the question reads 'one-arm-db-row needs dumbbells and bench that is not available' although the athlete keeps dumbbells and bench.
findings.expected: Every option of a question has an effect, and an athlete who has really lost the equipment can record it: the question names the slot and the equipment actually missing, its missing inputs are inputs the review it answers reads (or it says which other review to send), and when no same-pattern configuration fits, the question offers a resolution that exists (for example the R6-SUBSTITUTION condition 8 path: the pattern left out and disclosed), or the plan does so. Which resolution is allowed after a SKILL_MISMATCH is the owner's and the SSCTR's call; the Quality requirement is only that one exists and the text is true.
findings.actual: In 13 of 46 reachable questions (including the R7-B.1 test fixture and a full-equipment athlete) the only way out is 'Keep the equipment', i.e. not recording the real loss, after which the plan keeps prescribing exercises that need the missing equipment. The text lists all of the substitute's equipment (need = configurationOf(g.substitute).equipment, src/r6-adaptation.mjs skillMismatchGap), not the missing items, and names the latest substitute of the chain, which is not always the slot that blocks (q12: the blocking slot is the band-row MAIN row whose natural fallback is the set-aside db-row).
findings.owner: Runtime author (R7-B.1 correction cycle); SSCTR consulted if the resolution changes which configuration a SKILL_MISMATCH slot may take

findings.category: CONTRADICTION WITH THE PLAN / TRUTHFULNESS (residual of QE-R7B-OBS-04 and QE-R7B-R2-04 under calendar rotation)
findings.origin: Pre-existing: identical on FREEZE-2 (q08 W1, W2, W4). Not introduced by R7-B.1, but the delta closes OBS-04 and R2-04 and this is their residual on rotation programs; the closure records and tests do not cover it.
findings.title: Under EVERY_2_WEEKS rotation, a reason-based substitution of a rotation-placed exercise puts an unnamed configuration in its slot; in the taper week that configuration is never performed in the program and nothing is disclosed
reproduction: probes/q08-rotation-residual.mjs -> out/q08-rotation-residual-R7B1.json and -FREEZE2.json. W1: 10K on 2027-01-17, 12 weeks, FULL, GENERAL, strength days [0,2,4], EVERY_2_WEEKS, weekly reviews to the TAPER week (9); EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION push-up NONCLINICAL_DISCOMFORT_OR_PREFERENCE (confirmed) on day 0 06:00 -> MODIFY 'push-up is replaced by db-bench-press', disclosures []. w9-str-d2 (TAPER, instruction 'Taper: fewer sets at familiar loads; no new exercises or heavier loads'): before db-bench-press:MAIN, db-row:MAIN, push-up:ACCESSORY, kb-row:ACCESSORY, dead-bug:ACCESSORY; after db-bench-press:MAIN, db-row:MAIN, incline-push-up:ACCESSORY, kb-row, dead-bug. incline-push-up is never performed in this program. W2 (16 weeks, inverted-row -> db-row; band-row new in w10-str-d2) and W4 (RUNNING_SUPPORT, kb-row -> db-row; inverted-row new in w10-str-d2): the same. W3 (BANDS_AND_BAR, glute-bridge -> single-leg-glute-bridge): the decision now carries NO_NEW_EXERCISE_IN_EVENT_WEEKS, but the same proposal changes the calf slot of w10-str-d0 to single-leg-calf-raise, never performed, which the disclosure does not mention.

probes/q01-event-week.mjs (3 shards) -> out/q01-event-week-*.json: C1 (a configuration new to the event weeks and never performed) fails in 24 of 6,888 applied decisions, every recorded example under EVERY_2_WEEKS.

probes/q09c-slot.mjs -> out/q09c-slot-R7B1.json / -FREEZE2.json (non-event weeks, 12-week PERFORMANCE, week-4 substitutions): decisions whose replaced slot does not take the selected exercise because it is already in the session: FREEZE-2 33 / 32 / 32 (EVERY_2_WEEKS / COACH_DECIDES / FIXED), R7-B.1 6 / 0 / 0. The 6 residual decisions are all rotation-placed ACCESSORY exercises (push-up, kb-row) beside the selected one as MAIN; slipsFrom inspects template rows only, so it does not see an exercise placed by rotation.
findings.expected: The plan prescribes what the decision selects in every slot of the replaced exercise, rotation slots included (QE-R7B-01); in TAPER, RACE_WEEK and POST_EVENT no configuration this program never performed enters through a reason-based substitution, and any stand-in or omission is disclosed (QE-R7B-OBS-04; the session's own taper instruction).
findings.actual: On EVERY_2_WEEKS programs the replaced rotation slot takes a configuration the decision does not name; in event weeks it is a new exercise, without a disclosure, in a session whose instruction says 'no new exercises'.
findings.owner: Runtime author; the SSCTR judges whether this keeps QE-R7B-OBS-04 open (sports-science adequacy is theirs)

findings.origin: Created by R7-B.1 (the new end of the candidate loop in exerciseSubstitution, QE-R7B-R2-04 path)
findings.title: The new 'Every admissible alternative ... is already in a session with X' question offers 'Add equipment', which has no effect in most cases, and says every alternative is taken although naming one works
reproduction: probes/q03-all-candidates-in-session.mjs -> out/q03-all-candidates-in-session.json (the p04 grid; week-2 substitutions): 2,356 decisions, 41 such questions (front-plank SKILL_MISMATCH 27; prone-ytw-raise 14). 'Add equipment' (an EQUIPMENT_CHANGE to every catalog item, then the same substitution): no effect 26/41, impossible 3/41 (the athlete already has every item). Naming another same-pattern exercise (the question's missing input substitution.to, not listed among its options) works in 27/41 (e.g. bird-dog, side-plank, pallof-press for front-plank, although the question says 'every admissible alternative of the same pattern (dead-bug)'). Only 'Keep X' resolves 2/41.

probes/q02-p04-witness-delta.mjs -> out/q02-p04-witness-delta.json: the p04 witness FULL/GENERAL/4 days/NOVICE front-plank SKILL_MISMATCH was MODIFY -> dead-bug at FREEZE-2 (dead-bug already in a session with front-plank) and is this question now.
findings.expected: Options with an effect; the text states why (the alternatives of that reason's rule are already in the session) and offers naming another exercise when that works.
findings.actual: options ['Add equipment','Keep X'] with disclosure NO_ADMISSIBLE_ALTERNATIVE, reused from the no-candidate case where adding equipment can help.

findings.title: A weekly review that leaves an event-week slot out (substitute planned before the taper, then missed) discloses nothing
reproduction: probes/q10-weekly-silent-omission.mjs -> out/q10-weekly-silent-omission.txt: 10K/16 weeks, DUMBBELLS+BENCH+KETTLEBELL, FIXED; in the last SPECIFIC week db-rdl -> single-leg-rdl-db (preference), no event-week disclosure (the substitute is planned before the taper); the session holding it is not done; the weekly review (MODIFY GATED_NEXT_STEP) leaves the hinge out of w10-str-d4 (TAPER) and w12-str-d4 (POST_EVENT). Its result has disclosures [] and the sessions no text; only the session field eventStandIns [{selected:'single-leg-rdl-db',setAside:'db-rdl',inEventWeeks:null}] records it.

findings.title: In a program that ends with the post-event week, the second option and the rest-by-design text speak of 'after the post-event week'
reproduction: probes/q07-event-option-effect.mjs -> out/q07-event-option-effect.json: 16-week program: option 2 works (the same substitution in the first week after POST_EVENT -> MODIFY, X gone, no event-week disclosure). 12-week program ending at POST_EVENT: no week follows, the same request on the last day -> ASK 'not in the sessions still ahead'; the detail correctly says 'beyond this program'.
probes/q06-rest-by-design.mjs -> out/q06-rest-by-design.json: 12-week program: the race-week session becomes rest by design with 'the exercises of this session start after the post-event week'.
findings.expected: Where no week follows, the option and the text say the change applies beyond this program.
findings.actual: 'make this change after the post-event week' and 'start after the post-event week' (the decision's detail is correct).
